notes: Each row represents a distinct food item identified by a numeric NHANES food code (DRXFDCD). The short description (DRXFCSD) is used as the primary concept_name, while the long description (DRXFCLD) is stored as a synonym to preserve additional context. The domain is set to Food and a new local vocabulary NHANES_Food_Code is created to house these concepts. No additional relationships are required beyond the single concept per row.
harmonization_reasoning: All files represent USDA food items and already use the Food domain. The majority use the vocabulary name NHANES_Food_Code; only one file used NHANES_Food, which is a variant of the same local vocabulary. Harmonizing to NHANES_Food_Code ensures all concepts map to a single vocabulary. For concept_class_id, the most common value is "Food" (used in 8 of 10 files). The occasional "Food Code" or "Food_Code" variants are treated as synonyms and can be mapped to the standard "Food" class. This choice maximizes consistency and minimizes fragmentation across years.
domain_id_correction_note: Changed from 'Food' to 'Observation' -- 'Food' is not a real OMOP CDM 5.3 domain (verified against official OHDSI CommonDataModel docs); the LLM's earlier claim that it was a built-in domain was incorrect.
